title: Trump Sold Palm Beach Mansion to Rybolovlev’s Company for $95 Million in 2008
description_short: In July 2008, Trump sold the Palm Beach estate to Dmitry Rybolovlev’s company for a recorded $95 million.
description_medium: The Palm Beach Post reported that Trump’s sale of the 515 N. County Road estate closed in July 2008 for $95 million to County Road Property LLC, owned by Dmitry Rybolovlev. The deed listed $95 million, though Trump described the deal as a $100 million sale. The reporting documents the transaction and price, but does not establish that the sale was $40 million above market value.
description_long: Reporting by The Palm Beach Post identifies Trump’s Palm Beach property as the former Abe Gosman estate at 515 N. County Road. The paper’s 2008 account, reproduced in its 2016 article, says Trump bought the six-acre oceanfront property for $41.35 million in 2004 as part of the health-care magnate’s bankruptcy filing. It reports that Trump sold it in July 2008 to County Road Property LLC; Dmitry Rybolovlev later acknowledged that he was the buyer. The deed listed $95 million, although Trump described the deal as a $100 million sale, and the article says the final price was adjusted downward during last-minute negotiations. Trump said, “At the same time, I believe the buyer made an absolutely fantastic deal, and time will prove this right.” A 2020 Palm Beach Post account again identifies a July 2008 closing at $95 million and reports that it was then the most expensive price paid for a single-family house. These reports document the sale, buyer, and recorded amount. They do not supply a contemporaneous appraisal or comparable-sales analysis showing that the price was $40 million above market value, so this correction leaves that valuation claim and claims about the buyer’s purpose out.
